description: TN-ITS is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer. The Flemish TN-ITS service is available via the Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer and operational as a pilot service since 2016. The service mainly publishes changes of speed limits and traffic restrictions for roads in the Flemish region, supporting both point and linear features. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in XML. The data standards named are tn-its. The national access point types are MMTIS, RTTI. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
